one_area_pin.name: one_area_pin
one_area_pin.where: "site_locations"."site_area_id" is not null and "site_locations"."deactivated_at" is null

"site_locations"."deactivated_at" is null and exists (
    select 1 from public.sites s where s.id = "site_locations"."site_id" and s.is_public and s.deactivated_at is null)

public read.name: public read
public read.using:
"planting_lines"."deactivated_at" is null and exists (
    select 1 from public.planting_events e where e.id = "planting_lines"."event_id" and e.is_public and e.deactivated_at is null)

public.area_list.definition:
select a.slug as area, a.name as area_name, a.wrt_number, a.site_class,
    si.slug as site, si.name as site_name, si.is_scheme,
    pin.latitude, pin.longitude, pin.radius_m
  from public.site_areas a
  join public.sites si on si.id = a.site_id
  left join public.site_locations pin on pin.site_area_id = a.id and pin.deactivated_at is null
  where a.deactivated_at is null and si.deactivated_at is null
public.area_list.name: area_list

public.line_details.definition:
select l.id as line_id, e.id as event_id, l.legacy_code, e.source,
    se.slug as season, se.label as season_label, se.year, se.sort_order as season_order, e.planting_date,
    si.slug as site, si.name as site_name, si.is_scheme,
    a.slug as area, a.name as area_name, a.wrt_number, a.site_class,
    sp.slug as species, sp.scientific_name, sp.common_name, sp.maori_name,
    sp.over_5m, sp.threatened, sp.contested_group,
    l.quantity, l.needs_review
  
  from public.planting_lines l
  join public.planting_events e on e.id = l.event_id
  join public.seasons se       on se.id = e.season_id
  join public.site_areas a     on a.id = e.site_area_id
  join public.sites si         on si.id = a.site_id
  join public.species sp       on sp.id = l.species_id where l.deactivated_at is null and e.deactivated_at is null
public.line_details.name: line_details

public.totals_by_review_topic.definition:
with flagged as (
    select distinct n.topic_id, l.id, l.quantity
    from public.line_notes n join public.planting_lines l on l.id = n.line_id
    where l.needs_review and n.kind <> 'fyi' and n.deactivated_at is null and l.deactivated_at is null)
  select t.slug as topic, t.label, t.question, t.decision,
    coalesce(sum(f.quantity), 0) as plants_needs_review, count(f.id) as lines_needs_review
  from public.review_topics t left join flagged f on f.topic_id = t.id
  group by t.id
public.totals_by_review_topic.name: totals_by_review_topic

public.totals_by_season.definition:
select se.slug as season, se.label as season_label, se.sort_order as season_order, 
  coalesce(sum(l.quantity), 0)                                 as plants,
  coalesce(sum(l.quantity) filter (where not l.needs_review), 0) as plants_resolved,
  coalesce(sum(l.quantity) filter (where l.needs_review), 0)   as plants_needs_review,
  count(*)                                                     as lines,
  count(*) filter (where l.needs_review)                       as lines_needs_review,
    count(distinct si.id) as sites, count(distinct sp.id) as species
  
  from public.planting_lines l
  join public.planting_events e on e.id = l.event_id
  join public.seasons se       on se.id = e.season_id
  join public.site_areas a     on a.id = e.site_area_id
  join public.sites si         on si.id = a.site_id
  join public.species sp       on sp.id = l.species_id where l.deactivated_at is null and e.deactivated_at is null group by se.id
public.totals_by_season.name: totals_by_season

public.totals_by_site.definition:
select si.slug as site, si.name as site_name, si.is_scheme, 
  coalesce(sum(l.quantity), 0)                                 as plants,
  coalesce(sum(l.quantity) filter (where not l.needs_review), 0) as plants_resolved,
  coalesce(sum(l.quantity) filter (where l.needs_review), 0)   as plants_needs_review,
  count(*)                                                     as lines,
  count(*) filter (where l.needs_review)                       as lines_needs_review,
    count(distinct sp.id) as species, min(se.sort_order) as first_season_order, max(se.sort_order) as last_season_order
  
  from public.planting_lines l
  join public.planting_events e on e.id = l.event_id
  join public.seasons se       on se.id = e.season_id
  join public.site_areas a     on a.id = e.site_area_id
  join public.sites si         on si.id = a.site_id
  join public.species sp       on sp.id = l.species_id where l.deactivated_at is null and e.deactivated_at is null group by si.id
public.totals_by_site.name: totals_by_site

public.totals_by_species.definition:
select sp.slug as species, sp.scientific_name, sp.common_name, sp.maori_name, 
  coalesce(sum(l.quantity), 0)                                 as plants,
  coalesce(sum(l.quantity) filter (where not l.needs_review), 0) as plants_resolved,
  coalesce(sum(l.quantity) filter (where l.needs_review), 0)   as plants_needs_review,
  count(*)                                                     as lines,
  count(*) filter (where l.needs_review)                       as lines_needs_review,
    count(distinct si.id) as sites
  
  from public.planting_lines l
  join public.planting_events e on e.id = l.event_id
  join public.seasons se       on se.id = e.season_id
  join public.site_areas a     on a.id = e.site_area_id
  join public.sites si         on si.id = a.site_id
  join public.species sp       on sp.id = l.species_id where l.deactivated_at is null and e.deactivated_at is null group by sp.id
public.totals_by_species.name: totals_by_species
